doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Ory's instruments and his homemade first banjo
summary: Ory lists the instruments he plays, says valve trombone was first, and describes building homemade instruments.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: I still have it. You still use it? I only had saxophone, clarinet, trumpet and... and carnet, bass, valve trombone, I had a song like that.
Did you ever play valve trombone before you took up the slide or...
I played trumpet too, you know. What was your very... You know, if you'd say a couple of weeks I'd be perfect on it. Yeah. I used to sing the same with the valve. Yeah.
True. What was your very first instrument?

I made five instruments. Banjo, mandolin, bass, violin, guitar and a lead violin. I used to sing them up with fishing cards and... and different kind of wire we would get. And we sang along with it and fish riding.
